name: Starship Promise
source:
When your home colony falls to enemy forces, you’re forced to seek help from an unlikely crew of…space outlaws?! There’s no shortage of danger as you fight with them through the universe to save your colony. But the further you go, the more you come to realize that in space, love is limitless.

[From [url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/161867328178/starship-promise-new-pilot-series-out-now-when]Voltage Lovestruck blog[/url]]
translation:
当你的家乡落入敌军之手时，你被迫向一群不太可能的……太空亡命之徒寻求帮助？！当你在宇宙中与他们战斗以拯救你的殖民地时，危险并不存在。但走得越远，你就越发现，在太空中，爱是无限的。

[来自[url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/161867328178/starship-promise-new-pilot-series-out-now-when]Voltage Lovestruck博客[/url]]
